slides.texte_overlay: Tip 1: learn how things work, not just what they are. Engines, economies, the human body. Understanding systems makes you sharper in every area of life.
Tip 2: argue against your own opinions. Once a week, find the best argument for the side you disagree with. Real intelligence is seeing the whole picture.
Tip 3: spend time with people smarter than you. Ask them questions, listen, take notes. Being the least knowledgeable person in the room is how you grow fastest.
Tip 4: explain things out loud. Teach a friend what you learned this week. If you can explain it clearly and simply, you truly understand it.
Tip 5: learn a little every single day. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and small daily lessons add up to a seriously sharper mind.
slides.texte_sophia: Tip 5: learn a little every day. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. Small daily lessons add up to a seriously sharper mind.

slides.texte_overlay: Bonus: protect your sleep. Your brain sorts and stores everything you learned while you sleep. Seven or eight hours is the easiest intelligence upgrade there is.
Intelligence isn't a gift you have or don't. It's a habit you build. Pick one tip today, and keep it going for a month. You'll notice the difference.
